Laugh Factory Kid's Comedy Camp Auditions

FREE Laugh Factory Comedy Camp auditions for ages 9-16! Learn from Tiffany Haddish, Tehran, and Ron Pearson in this exciting in-person comedy experience for young performers. A parent or guardian is required to stay for the duration of the event. Young comedians will have the opportunity to build confidence, creativity, stage presence, and comedic skills in a fun and supportive environment led by comedy professionals and mentors. Please register one child per registration. If registering multiple children, please complete a separate registration for each child.

Features comedians:

Tiffany Haddish
Tehran
Ron Pearson

Prices, performers, and schedule are subject to change. A two-drink minimum purchase per patron is required.
Vouchers are not redeemable at the door.

Ramy Brook

Join us for A Night of Comedy with Ramy Brook, an elevated stand-up experience where fashion and comedy come together for a one-of-a-kind evening at Laugh Factory. Presented by Ramy Brook, this special event features a curated lineup of top comedians, all styled in Ramy Brook, bringing a fresh, fashion-forward energy to the stage. Designed as both a comedy show and a moment, the night blends high-style aesthetics with a lively, high-energy atmosphere, perfect for guests looking to enjoy great stand-up while being part of a scene. With Ramy Brook Sharp in attendance and a room full of tastemakers, creatives, and comedy fans, the evening is set to deliver not just laughs, but a memorable experience both on and off stage. Whether you're coming for the comedy, the style, or the vibe, this is not your typical night out at Laugh Factory.

Features comedians:

Rosebud Baker
Zainab Johnson
Crystal Marie
Brittany Ross
